text.en: Clients express strong appreciation for Russell Hartstein, highlighting his deep knowledge of animal behavior and compassionate approach. Reviewers emphasize that he treats pets like his own and provides calm, non-judgmental guidance for whole families. Pet parents value his commitment to long-term pet well-being through scientifically grounded methods.

Owners report impressive transformations in dogs dealing with severe reactivity, resource guarding, separation anxiety, and fear. Multiple clients note swift improvements, including dogs learning reliable recall and safely acclimating to newborn babies and household cats. Reviewers consistently praise the lasting behavioral progress achieved in training.

Pet owners frequently praise the thorough communication provided throughout training programs. Russell provides detailed daily written reports, photos, video commentary, and links to educational resources. Clients emphasize that these clear explanations empower handlers to continue consistent positive reinforcement techniques at home.

q.en: Does the trainer work with dog-and-cat households?

a.en: Yes, reviewers mention successful guidance on safely introducing reactive dogs to cats and creating peaceful home environments.

q.en: Are daily progress updates provided during bootcamps?

a.en: Yes, clients highlight receiving comprehensive daily written reports, photos, and video updates with practical commentary.

q.en: Can training address safety around newborn babies?

a.en: Yes, a reviewer noted tailored training that used sound recordings and desensitization to help their dog safely adapt to an infant.

q.en: What training philosophy does Fun Paw Care use?

a.en: The service utilizes force-free, positive reinforcement methodologies rooted in animal behavior science.
